text:
alex: heads-up — I'm onboarding lithos-7b to the model catalog. weights are at s3://redwood-models/lithos/lithos-7b/weights. quick blockers: 
- tokenizer contains an extra special token '<|response|>' that isn't present in tokenizer.json (we see it fall back to unk in local tests).
- runtime/container is throwing a kernel lookup error for the fused attention kernel (seems CUDA/Triton mismatch).
Can someone advise best short-term unblock and long-term fix?

priya: repro steps I ran locally:
1) pulled gcr runtime image: `gcr.io/redwood/runtime:cuda-12.1-2026-03-15`
2) started triton via our entrypoint, served model config pointing to s3 weights
3) got this error during model load:
```
2026-03-15T14:12:08.123Z ERROR kernel_selector: kernel not found: fused_attention_fp16
2026-03-15T14:12:08.124Z ERROR model_loader: failed to select kernel for attention -> aborting model load
```
Seems the compiled kernels in the container expect a different CUDA ABI.

marco: tokenizer note — lithos tokenizer was exported with an extra token used by the training infra. Fix is trivial: add "additional_special_tokens": ["<|response|>"] to tokenizer.json and re-run the conversion script (tokenizers/convert.py). I can open a PR to update the artifacts and re-upload weights.

jen: infra context — our shared base images moved to CUDA 12.1 recently to keep parity with some internal components, but a few of the custom attention kernels were built against CUDA 12.3 (and assume newer nvcc features). Options:
- rebuild the kernels for CUDA 12.1 (takes dev time and might miss perf fixes)
- standardize on CUDA 12.3 for the model runtime images and rebuild containers (simpler long-term)

I'm going to kick a CI container rebuild for lithos with CUDA=12.3. PR incoming to switch the Dockerfile base.

buildbot: CI update: `ci/container-rebuild-lithos7b` (run 4512) started. Early failure on compile step with previous image. Full logs: https://ci.redwood.internal/4512/logs (requires creds). Excerpt:
```
[ 12%] Building NVCC kernels
nvcc fatal   : Unknown option ' --extended-lambda'
make: *** [kernels] Error 2
```
Looks like mismatch in nvcc flags between host toolchain and container image.

priya: short-term workaround to unblock integration tests: add `RUNTIME_KERNEL_HINT: "generic"` to model config so runtime falls back to a generic attention impl. Perf will drop (~1.8-2x) but tests can run. I'm doing that now on the staging canary.

alex: thanks. @runtime-oncall can you watch the canary once the workaround is deployed and report p95? Also @marco can you upload the tokenizer patch ASAP so we don't have tokenization surprises in prod?

runtime-oncall: watching the staging canary. Will post p95/update in ~30m after a couple of synthetic runs.

jen: pushed change: infra/containers/Dockerfile.lithos7b now uses `nvidia/cuda:12.3.1-cudnn8-runtime-ubuntu22.04`. opened PR #789. Kicking rebuild with updated nvcc and build flags.

marco: opened PR #790 — adds `additional_special_tokens` to tokenizer.json, updates tokenizers/convert.py to preserve special tokens, and adds a small test `tests/tokenizer_special_tokens.py`. Uploading new artifact to s3 now (will post link when done).

buildbot: CI: `ci/container-rebuild-lithos7b` run 4516 queued -> started. Compile step now using nvcc 12.3.1; progress looks good.

priya: can confirm staging canary with `RUNTIME_KERNEL_HINT=generic` is serving — integration suite passed. p95 latency is ~220ms for chat endpoint (was ~120ms expected). tagging as temporary degrade.

alex: perfect — that's enough to unblock QA. Follow-ups:
- jen: please merge the cuda12.3 container PR and roll out to dedicated canaries.
- marco: confirm s3 artifact link + checksum here after upload.
- I'll update the model onboarding checklist with a couple of quick validation commands:
  - `python tooling/token-check.py --model s3://...` (verify special tokens)
  - `tritonserver --version` and `nvidia-smi` (validate CUDA/triton versions)

jen: will merge PR 789 after green CI. planning a canary deploy to dedicated in ~1h.

marco: uploaded new weights bundle -> s3://redwood-models/lithos/lithos-7b/weights-v2. sha256: abcdef123456... link: s3 console (internal). Also added tokenizer test to the model repo.

alex: awesome work, thanks everyone. I'll close this thread once PRs are merged and canary looks healthy.

runtime-oncall: canary p95 after new container is deployed: 125ms (within expected). No errors in model load. Will watch for 2h then sign off.

jen: merged and rolled — closing the infra loop.

alex: closing here — notes pushed to onboarding checklist doc: /docs/model-onboarding/checklist.md. If anything regresses re-open thread. :thumbsup:
